description: Payable non-OT hours for the day. Salary Slip SUMs this — do not re-derive it as working_hours minus OT hours, the daily OT cap breaks that identity.
label: Base Hours
name: Attendance-custom_base_hours

description: Total OT hours actually worked — buffer deducted.
label: Actual OT Hours (Worked)
name: Overtime Slip-custom_actual_ot_hours

description: OT hours after weekly and quarterly cap deduction. Used in salary formula.
label: Payable OT Hours
name: Overtime Slip-custom_payable_ot_hours

description: Users who get notified when OT thresholds are crossed.
label: Alert Recipients
name: Overtime Type-alert_recipients

description: Send alert when employee crosses this % of any cap (weekly/quarterly).
label: Alert Threshold %
name: Overtime Type-alert_threshold_percent

description: Employee must check-out MORE than this many minutes after shift end to earn evening OT.
label: Post-Shift Buffer (Minutes)
name: Overtime Type-post_shift_buffer_minutes

description: Employee must check-in MORE than this many minutes before shift start to earn morning OT.
label: Pre-Shift Buffer (Minutes)
name: Overtime Type-pre_shift_buffer_minutes

description: Maximum OT hours an employee can earn in one calendar quarter (Jan-Mar, Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep, Oct-Dec).
label: Quarterly Max OT Hours
name: Overtime Type-quarterly_max_ot_hours

description: Maximum OT hours an employee can earn in one week (Mon-Sun).
label: Weekly Max OT Hours
name: Overtime Type-weekly_max_ot_hours

description: OT hours after weekly and quarterly cap deduction. Used in salary formula.
label: Payable OT Hours
name: Salary Slip-custom_actual_ot_hours

description: Paid holiday hours for the period: Holiday List days x Standard Day Hours, less any Sunday removed by the Sunday Deduction Policy. Added to Regular Working Hours when pricing base pay, so holidays are paid explicitly rather than hidden inside the rate.
label: Holiday Hours
name: Salary Slip-custom_holiday_hours

description: OT hours after weekly and quarterly cap deduction. Used in salary formula.
label: Payable OT Hours
name: Salary Slip-custom_payable_ot_hours

description: How this employee's base pay was measured for this period, taken from their shift. 'Working Hours' pays hours x rate; 'Present / Absent' pays native payroll days.
label: Payroll Basis
name: Salary Slip-custom_payroll_basis

description: Sum of Attendance base hours for the period — use this in salary component formulas for basic pay.
label: Regular Working Hours
name: Salary Slip-custom_regular_working_hours

description: Hours in one full working day on this employee's shift for the period. Divisor for the hourly rate: base / 26 / custom_standard_day_hours. Follows the shift's own duration so 8.5h and 8h shifts price correctly.
label: Standard Day Hours
name: Salary Slip-custom_standard_day_hours

description: Hours in a full month on this shift: the period's working days (calendar days minus Holiday List days) x Standard Day Hours. Divisor for base pay, so full attendance pays exactly base in every month regardless of how many holidays it contains.
label: Standard Month Hours
name: Salary Slip-custom_standard_month_hours

description: Sum of Attendance working hours for the period. Reference only.
label: Total Working Hours
name: Salary Slip-custom_total_working_hours

description: Apply the Overtime Type's pre/post shift buffers as a grace period. ON: time inside the buffer is paid as normal hours, not overtime, and overtime is capped at whichever ends of the day were genuinely outside the shift window. OFF with Minimum Hours set: every minute past that threshold is overtime, wherever it fell. OFF with Minimum Hours at 0: any minute outside the shift window is overtime.
label: Apply Shift Buffers
name: Shift Type-custom_apply_ot_buffers

description: Cap a day's base hours at one full shift day (shift duration less the unpaid lunch break). ON: an employee finishing 6 minutes late on an 8.5 h shift with a 30-minute break is credited 8.00, not 8.10 — time absorbed by the OT buffer is discarded rather than paid as normal hours. OFF: base follows hours actually worked, so buffer time is still paid at normal rate. Applies whether or not the shift allows overtime.
label: Cap Base Hours at Shift Hours
name: Shift Type-custom_cap_base_at_shift_hours

description: Unpaid break, deducted from EVERY hour figure on this shift: the working hours stored on Attendance, the standard day used for paid leave, Work From Home and holidays, the monthly divisor on the Salary Slip, and the overtime rate. Set it to 0 for a shift with no unpaid break. Changing it does not rewrite existing Attendance — recompute those rows to apply it. If Minimum Hours Before OT Starts is in use, lower it by the same amount.
label: Lunch Break (Minutes)
name: Shift Type-custom_lunch_break_minutes

description: Total hours that must be worked before OT begins, counting hours inside AND outside the shift window — so a late arrival is made up before any overtime is earned. Set it to what a full normal day yields as Attendance working hours on this shift. The pre/post shift buffers STILL APPLY unless you untick Apply Shift Buffers. Leave 0 for the legacy window model, where overtime is measured purely from the shift start/end times.
label: Minimum Hours Before OT Starts
name: Shift Type-custom_ot_qualifying_hours

description: Pay the hours actually worked on a day marked Absent. A short day falls under the shift's Absent threshold and pays nothing by default. ON: the day still pays for time on site, net of the unpaid break, and the base cap applies as usual. The Attendance status is NOT changed — the register still shows Absent for leave and discipline; only the hours become payable. Leave OFF to keep native behaviour, where an Absent day is worth nothing.
label: Pay Worked Hours on Absent Days
name: Shift Type-custom_pay_hours_when_absent

description: How this shift's base pay is measured. 'Working Hours' (default) pays on hours actually worked; paid leave, Work From Home and holidays are credited a full shift day. 'Present / Absent' keeps native payroll-day behaviour and writes no hours. Requires a Salary Component formula reading custom_regular_working_hours + custom_holiday_hours.
label: Payroll Basis
name: Shift Type-custom_payroll_basis
